browser_request_counts.note: Run2 and resume are sequential same-candidate harness phases. Only one real Google ASR request exists in the app audit log.

security_and_policy_evidence.late_body_write_control: post-dispatch timeout/cancel/late-text discard covered by 60 focused offline tests; no live invalid Google call was made

not_browser_validated: 401/403/429/empty/malformed-completed/timeout/cancel provider classes were not re-sent to live Google; they are covered by the focused offline fake-transport suite to avoid invalid calls/quota burn.
Missing/deleted credential live unavailable state was not created through a destructive API (no delete route); covered by offline tests and the live disabled state.
H2 literal leading thought and Lena/Lina known model defects were not re-run; H1 only was used for lifecycle/function evidence.
Google recognition quality is not a PASS gate here; this is one synthetic licensed H1 sample and does not validate human/noisy/accented/long/multilingual audio, timestamps, or diarization.
Cloud Run RAM/cold-start/concurrency/real quota were not measured; local process RSS is reported only as a local observation.
The full Tasks/Board/Team browser suite, broad fuzzing and new video/TTS were intentionally not repeated; only core legacy Task/scope and the ASR-sensitive paths were checked.
No deployment, push, release, root service restart or production account/data change was performed; 8123 remains the deployed 1.20.0 service.
known_accepted_model_output_defects: H2 literal word thought inside final model_output remains accepted/not rewritten; parser ignores real thought steps only.
H2 Lena->Lina and date-surface changes remain known defects; no sample-word hardcoding was introduced.
observations: Receipt v2 item field `formal_path` is a legacy field name and can point at derivative/machine.vN.md on the text-ready row even before a human formal version exists. The tested UI does not use it as proof of a formal version; the formal/machine API boundary was verified separately via content?kind=formal/machine. Recorded as an observation, not a transcription-success blocker.
The one H1 transcript uses “North Harbor Market” and “April 9th” (capitalization/surface form differ from the prototype reference). This is accepted model output, not a quality gate.
